structured.answer: I'd pick the first one, א, the two piles of coins. It says it in one plain sentence: every shekel you put in "נהיה 3.70 ₪ בקרן ו-1.09 ₪ בחשבון ניירות ערך", and under the piles there are two big numbers, 66,513 ₪ against 19,595 ₪. That's enough for me to see the קרן is worth it because the employer adds money. The other two scared me with minus signs, pink stripes and a lot of numbers.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the long orange and grey paragraph under the three boxes
stuck.why: It's tiny and runs the whole width of the screen. I lost the line in the middle and there were English letters, S&P500 and 4D, so I gave up on it.

stuck.where: Screen 2, the table under the coins
stuck.why: The line "מס במשיכה −13,974 ₪" has a minus and pink stripes. For a moment I thought the קרן loses money. Then I saw that 66,513 is still the bigger number at the bottom.

stuck.where: Screen 2 to 3, the year bars above the coins
stuck.why: Year 5 and then year 6 are marked, and the numbers jump (66,513 becomes 98,738). I didn't understand right away that it's the same drawing for a different year. The page says you can drag, but I don't do that.
The heading says "אחרי 5 שנים" but the chart is in thousands up to 200,000. The pink striped box hanging in the air with −13,974 above it worried me.

used: The A heading "מגדלי מטבעות" and the explanation that gold is the employer's money
The sentence "כל שקל שהפקדתם נהיה 3.70 ₪ בקרן ו-1.09 ₪ בחשבון ניירות ערך"
The first rows of the table: הפקדות שלכם 18,000 / הפקדות המעסיק 54,000 against "אין"
The top box "הכסף של המעסיק +900 ₪ בחודש"
skimmed: The other two boxes at the top (+32,225, +1,721)
The year bars with "לפני 6 שנים: מס" and "מ-6 שנים: פטור ממס"
The B (staircase) chart and its numbers
The C chart, "כל השנים בעמודות", the coloured bars with the white line
skipped: The small orange and grey paragraph of example assumptions on screen 1
The small grey lines under the table about 19 tracks and 14 funds
unsure_meaning: "מיטב השתלמות עוקב מדד": מדד here isn't the price index I know
"רווח אחרי דמי ניהול", the turquoise dots
The pink striped coins: is that tax?
"מומלץ" next to A: who recommends it?
The numbers with dotted lines under them, maybe something you can press
not_found: Anything about deposits or a safe option
A plain sentence saying whether the קרן can go down
How much the bank or the fund takes from me in money, not in percent

findings.what: The whole page is black with grey and pale letters. Even enlarged with my glasses on, the small grey writing is very hard to read.
findings.where: Whole page, especially the notes under the charts

findings.what: The assumptions paragraph is tiny, full width, in orange and grey, with English letters (S&P500, 4D) and percentages. I gave up on it.
Minus signs and pink stripes for tax (−13,974 ₪) make you think there's a loss. I almost backed away.
findings.where: The A table and the B staircase

findings.what: C is crowded: lots of colours, a white line and big numbers on the side. It's hard to tell the turquoise from the green, and the pink from the stripes.
The "each shekel became 3.70" sentence is the only thing that explained everything to me plainly. It's worth keeping and making bigger.
The numbers change between screens (66,513, then 98,738) with nothing to say why, apart from a small circle on the year.
findings.where: The bars above the coins, screens 2–3

findings.what: The first boxes have three numbers at once (+900, +32,225, +1,721). I didn't know which one matters.
